title: The survey records a price sensitivity block
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the survey submission story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the rest of this epic
- **Unblocks:** the price readout, in the market research epic

---
Four questions in the Van Westendorp form — too cheap, a bargain, expensive, too expensive — asked about the all-in monthly cost including AWS and tokens, not about the Chatticus fee alone.

This is the instrument that answers what the product is worth. Beta volumes will never reach significance on a split price test, so there will not be one; the crossings of these four curves bracket the acceptable range from a few dozen responses, which is the sample that will exist.

Asking it about the fee alone would produce a clean curve for the wrong number.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Waitlist survey submission

  Scenario: A signup carries four price answers
    Given a visitor on the beta page
    When they complete the survey including the price block
    Then the waitlist signup records a too-cheap price
    And it records a bargain price
    And it records an expensive price
    And it records a too-expensive price

  Scenario: The price block asks about total monthly cost
    Given the beta page survey
    Then the price questions name the total including AWS and model tokens
